intro.name: Kelsey O'Briant
intro.bio: I am a Creative Director, formerly an Art Director, formerly a child. I work at Fallon in Minneapolis, making things up in my brain, on my computer, and sometimes on airplanes.

contact.heading: I'm a Creative Director, formerly an Art Director, formerly a Child.
contact.blurb: My partner [Tanner](https://tanneruselmann.party/) and I work at [Fallon](https://fallon.com/) in Minneapolis, MN. They mostly have us using our imaginations, going on the computer, and getting on airplanes.
contact.details: Minneapolis is the fourth best place in the world after my childhood home in Houston, Disneyland in Anaheim, and the American Girl Doll Store in Chicago.

projects.title: Once A Princess, Always A Princess
projects.blurb: A short film made by friends, for friends. A love letter to the magic of girlhood and moviemaking, with no corners cut.

projects.title: Drawn To You
projects.blurb: There is no limit to what Wish Kids can wish for. So learning that half of all Make-A-Wish wishes are Disney wishes floored me. We made this work to honor not just the granting of the wish, but the genesis of it. Joy and creativity are as good for us as any medicine.

projects.title: Want The World
projects.blurb: The Venetian is a Las Vegas resort with gondolas inside. This is not a normal place. My inner Veruca Salt (you know, the horrible greedy brat from Willy Wonka) began singing on my first visit. So she made it into the ads.

projects.title: Pusha T: Rib Roast
projects.blurb:
Some things you might not know:
1. Pusha T loves Arby's
2. Pusha T hates McDonalds because he wrote the "I'm Lovin' It" jingle and they didn’t pay him what he was owed.

Revenge is best served on a bun, on a mechanical bull, in an Arby’s parking lot.

projects.title: Be Our Guest
projects.blurb: Moms make it all happen. But what if, for once, we made it happen for her? An ode to every Princess, big or small, old or young, in a castle or in a world of their own imagination. Music by the nicest/genius-est man in showbiz, Jacob Collier.

projects.title: More Babies, Please
projects.blurb: Millennials are not having very many babies compared to every single generation before them. This is an especially big problem for classic yellow box Cheerios, because their target market is babies. People still aren’t having as many babies, but at least Cheerios sales went up 7% after running this spot during the Grammys.

projects.title: We Like How You Party
projects.blurb: I like it international, and I expect to be delighted. I have never had more fun at work than I did making these. If your name is Karen and you did the wardrobe for these, please contact me. I love you and I miss you.

projects.title: Keep Your Body Working
projects.blurb: Facials aren't scary or a big deal. Especially if you do little ones, a little more often. Here are some famous and charming comedians to walk you through that whole thing.
